Directory research 2026-10-04: Nationally known touring band (not a local Long Island act); the listing is a ticketed concert at Mulcahy's, not a dance night. No booking agent is named on the band site; email is the band's general info address. The X link on the site uses twitter.com/lessthanjake (recorded as x.com). Only one non-text band photo on the site (other banners have album-art text over the photo). The logo is the band's long-time cartoon mascot (site icon, 250 px).
description: A touring ska-punk band from Gainesville, Florida, playing fast, upbeat punk songs with trombone and saxophone since the 1990s. It comes to Long Island on its national tours, such as the Northeast to Nowhere tour at Mulcahy's in Wantagh.

logo.alt: Less Than Jake cartoon mascot: a grinning face with spiky yellow hair and its tongue out
